opinions.rationale: The claim asserts a methodological gap: no outcome-blind procedure currently exists for selecting the time grid or grace period, nor is there a standard for reporting sensitivity to these choices. The reason given (that outcome-based selection induces selection bias, and clinical intervals are not purely data-driven) coherently supports why this gap exists and why it remains open. The claim is pitched at the right level of generality, describing a current absence in practice rather than a structural impossibility, as evidenced by the proposed direction to build such a procedure.
